_description: POISON FIXTURE (tests/fixtures/poison): the declaration file with unremediated_acceptances removed — the shape the repo had before 2026-11-13, when a 116 -> 47 fall over a 7-30 day window was reported as a backlog being worked down while 110 of the 116 rows were still open. The gate must name it UNDECLARED.

unlocked_fixes.window: rows only: unlocked_fixes_all WHERE is_recent, i.e. audit_runs.created_at > now() - 14 days
unlocked_fixes.comparable: byMode.code + agedOutByMode.code, which aging cannot reduce; or name the cohort explicitly with a fixed date range against unlocked_fixes_all

unlocked_fixes_all.window: columns only: is_recent carries the 14-day test; rows are NOT filtered, so a count over this view is stable and a count over is_recent is not
unlocked_fixes_all.comparable: the unfiltered count, or a fixed `fixed_at` range

unremediated_acceptances_all.window: columns only: days_open, is_mature and is_recent are clock-derived; rows are NOT filtered
unremediated_acceptances_all.comparable: the unfiltered count filtered on is_open_disposition alone

persona_density_per_repo.window: column only: density_30d counts persona_test_sessions from the last 30 days; the row set (one per repo) is stable
persona_density_per_repo.comparable: a count over persona_test_sessions with a fixed created_at range

persona_dashboard.window: column only: days_since_last_test is measured from now(); the row set (one per persona) is stable
persona_dashboard.comparable: last_tested_at itself, which is an instant and does not drift
